title: Distance OQ correct
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates d = 2R₁ - 2R₂ and obtains the final answer d = mv/(3qB₀).

title: Time interval Δt correct
description: Essential: Student correctly determines Δt for particle A passing point P twice as Δt = 2πm/(qB₀).

title: Minimum q'/m' correct
description: Essential: Student identifies the minimum charge-to-mass ratio for particle B as q'/m' = 2q/m.

title: Radius formulas applied
description: Important: Student correctly applies qvB = mv²/R to find radii R₁, R₂ for particle A and R₁', R₂' for particle B in both fields.

title: Period formulas applied
description: Important: Student correctly calculates half-periods T₁/2 and T₂/2 for motion in each magnetic field region.

title: Synchronization condition
description: Important: Student establishes that the times for A and B to reach points P and Q are equal, leading to equations involving n cycles.

title: Geometric progression analysis
description: Important: Student analyzes the vertical displacement per cycle for particle B (d' = 2R₁' - 2R₂') and relates it to OQ.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns the direction of magnetic force or confuses the sign of charge, affecting circular motion direction.

title: Radius mismatch error
description: Pitfall: Student uses the wrong magnetic field strength (e.g., 2B₀ vs. 3B₀) when calculating radii for the left/right regions.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student demonstrates unit analysis for final answers (d, Δt, q'/m') to verify dimensional consistency.
